notes: lewd maps directly to PurityVice (lewd*); tasteful implies decency, a purity virtue.
strict relates to authority/discipline; lenient relates to reduced enforcement of rules.
refined maps to PurityVirtue (refined); the purity foundation underlies notions of elevated, noble living.
trust and suspicion relate to reciprocal altruism and fairness expectations.
innocent maps to PurityVirtue (innocent); worldly implies the opposite of purity/naivety.
honorable maps to AuthorityVirtue (honor*); cunning implies deception touching fairness and general morality.
cooperative relates to loyalty/group solidarity and fairness through reciprocal altruism.
bravery is a widely recognized virtue with general moral valence, though not specific to one MFT foundation.
spiritual maps to PurityVirtue; purity foundation underlies spirituality.
ferocious relates to harm/violence (HarmVice); pacifist relates to peace (HarmVirtue).
submissive maps to AuthorityVirtue (submi*); dominant relates to liberty foundation as dominance/oppression.
forgiving relates to care/compassion; vengeful relates to fairness (reciprocity/justice); both poles carry broad moral valence.
